paper.title_en: Interior gravitational perturbations to naked singularities of a scalar field
paper.abstract_en: For the $k$-self-similar naked singularity solutions of Einstein--scalar field equations constructed by Christodoulou, we construct a family of interior gravitational perturbations leading to trapped surface formation that remain large but finite at the threshold Hölder regularity, while converging to zero in all regularities below the threshold. This extends the interior spherically symmetric result below the threshold in \cite{Li25} to non-spherically symmetric setting. We further construct a genuinely localized family of perturbations whose angular support shrinks to a single point, with smooth convergence to zero away from that point. This exploits the additional angular freedom available beyond spherical symmetry. Moreover, when measured instead in Sobolev regularity, such genuinely localized family of perturbations still converges to zero in all regularities below the same threshold.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究Einstein-标量场方程的裸奇点解在内部引力扰动下的行为，涉及阈Hölder正则性、俘获面形成与非球对称局部化扰动，属于广义相对论基础与数学物理的核心问题，理论深度较高，方法有清晰构造，且具有非球对称推广的新意。
decision.title_zh: 标量场裸奇点的内部引力扰动
decision.abstract_zh: 对于Christodoulou构造的Einstein--标量场方程的$k$-自相似裸奇点解，我们构造了一族内部引力扰动，这些扰动导致俘获面形成，在阈值Hölder正则性处保持大但有限，而在所有低于阈值的正则性中收敛到零。这将\cite{Li25}中阈值以下的内部球对称结果推广到非球对称情形。我们进一步构造了一族真正局部化的扰动，其角向支撑收缩到单个点，在该点之外光滑地收敛到零。这利用了球对称之外可用的额外角向自由度。此外，当改用Sobolev正则性来度量时，这样的真正局部化扰动族在低于同一阈值的所有正则性中仍然收敛到零。
